full_judgment:
Md Rezaul Hasan J : This rule has been issued at the instance of the accused petitioner calling upon opposite Party to show cause as to why the proceedings of Gulshan Police Station Case No. 14 dated 16-4-2006 corresponding to GR Case No. 143 of 2006 under section 406/ 420/109/465/467 of the Penal Code pending before the Court of learned Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka should not be quashed and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 4. The said complaint petition, was forwarded by the learned Magistrate to Gulshan police Station for investigation by, treating the same as FIR, where upon Gulshan PS Case No.14 dated 16-4-2006 under section 406/420/ 109/465/467 of the Penal Code was recorded and where from arose the corresponding GR Case No 143 of 2006. 

 9. Thereafter, the accused petitioner filed this petition under section 56A of the code of Criminal Procedure (the Code) challenging the proceedings of Gulshan PS case No. 14 dated 16-4-2006 corresponding to GP case No. 143 of 2006 and obtained the instant rule. 

 15. Adverting to the submission advanced by the petitioner to the effect that the order of further investigation dated 28-2-2008 passed by the learned Magistrate in GR Case No. 143 of 2006 was passed based on a 'protest petition' although there was no signature on the protest petition and even without examining the attorney of the complainant. Hence, the same is not legal. Upon examination of the record we also find that the 'naraji petition' dated 15-8-2007 was not signed by the attorney of the complainant or by the complainant himself, as such we do not consider this unsigned naraji petition as a petition in the eye of law. We also find that the learned Magistrate did not examine the person who is said to have filed this naraji petition. Indeed, the question to examine the person who filed this unsigned 'naraji petition' does not arise. Hence, nothing wrong was done by the learned Magistrate for not examining the said attorney on such unsigned naraji petition and there was no basis to pass any order on such a naraji petition.
